<includeonly>{{#cargo_query:
tables=ObtainedFrom
|fields=ItemKey,Probability,IsGuaranteed,Quantity
|where=SourceType="drop" AND SourceKey="{{{stablekey|}}}" AND Origin="generated"
|order by=ItemKey ASC
|format=template
|template=Character/DroppedByQueryRow
|named args=yes
|delimiter=<br />
|default=
}}</includeonly><noinclude>Renders item drops through item-owned ObtainedFrom Cargo rows.</noinclude>
